svg.aria-label: Automation. Browser and HTTP: Playwright and Camoufox where a page needs a real browser, curl_cffi and aiohttp where it does not, async pipelines with retries, proxy pools and per-account profiles, a React and Flask dashboard. Mail and auth flows: IMAP polling for verification links and OTP codes, OAuth 2.0 chains, session cookies and 2FA scripted end to end. Bots and schedulers: aiogram Telegram bots with a publishing queue (igtg, 251 tests), weekly report jobs, lead collection from OpenStreetMap, GitHub Actions and Azure Functions.
